query: Rewrite the old /Pages/ links to /SitePages/ in these documents using rules.json. Show me what would change.
expected_behavior: Loads the ruleset with load_ruleset and calls plan_remediation(documents, ruleset)
Reports the plan outcome and would_change without writing anything
Makes no tenant write and uses no built-in host or URL

query: Apply the plan now, I do not have a writer or a token, just do it.
expected_behavior: Explains a real apply needs an injected writer (else WriterRequired) and confirm=plan.confirmation_token (else ConfirmationRequired)
Does not fabricate a writer or reuse a stale token
Keeps the run a dry run until both exist

query: Half the writes failed with a permission error. Mark the run as done.
expected_behavior: Reports PARTIAL or FORBIDDEN honestly and does not call the run a success
Does not flatten the permission denial into a generic failure
Offers rollback_remediation under the same gates if the user wants to undo
